Goal

To Design A Seamless And Intuitive Job Search Experience That Empowers Users To Find And Apply For Jobs With Ease And Confidence.

Tools

Time Taken

The Entire Project Was Designed And Wrapped Up In About One Week, Including Ideation And Visual Refinement.

JobFinder- UI Exploration

Job Finder Is A Well-Designed Mobile App That Makes It Easier For Users To Search And Apply For Jobs. It Offers A Simple, Clean Interface With Easy Navigation. From Organized Job Listings To Detailed Filters, Every Feature Is Meant For Clarity And Convenience. The Goal Is To Make The Job-Hunting Process Smoother And Help Every Applicant Feel More Confident.

What I Learned

By Working On This Project, I Refined My Skills For Creating Transparent User-Centered Flows And Enhanced My Skill For Sustaining Visual Continuity While Balancing Functionality With Creativity.

"Design is not just how it looks — it’s how clearly it guides."
